Kuvio · Odoo Integration Help

Type: HTTP REST API Connection

Platform: Kuvio IoT telemetry platform for water monitoring devices

1) Connection Configuration

Connection uses HTTP REST API with token authentication.

URL Base field

The connector reads the API base URL from the remote control field URL Base.

connection_params (JSON)

Only credentials are required in connection_params:

{
  "username": "your_email@example.com",
  "password": "your_password"
}

2) Authentication Flow

The connector logs in at POST /auth/login and stores the token during execution.

Procedure 1: Get Devices (Manual)

Fetches all devices from Kuvio and generates a JSON attachment.

  1. Get Devices - Authenticates if needed, resolves customerId, paginates devices, and creates attachment.

Procedure 2: Daily Telemetry Sync (Scheduled)

Synchronizes historical telemetry readings for configured sensors.

  1. Login - Obtain authentication token
  2. Create Sensor Plan - Builds plan from existing Odoo sensors/devices
  3. Get Historical Readings - Downloads and upserts all returned points

3) Available Procedures

A) Kuvio: Get Devices

Manual procedure to fetch the device catalog from all API pages.

  • Uses endpoint: GET /customer/{customerId}/devices?pageSize=100&page=N
  • Follows pagination using hasNext / totalPages
  • Creates a JSON attachment on the remotecontrol record
  • Each device entry is filtered to: id and name

B) Kuvio: Daily Telemetry Sync

Scheduled procedure to retrieve readings and store them idempotently.

4) Device Configuration

Devices and sensors must exist in Odoo and be configured with remotecontrol parameters.

Each mdm.measurement.device stores:

  • remotecontrol_id = Kuvio remote control
  • remotecontrol_params (JSON) with device_id and optional start_date

Example device params:

{
  "device_id": "device_uuid_from_kuvio",
  "start_date": "2026-01-15"
}

Start date/time priority used in telemetry sync

  • 1) Last reading timestamp of the device (any sensor), plus 1 ms
  • 2) Device start_date (if no previous readings)
  • 3) January 1st of current year (fallback)

5) Sensor Configuration

Sensors are taken from existing Odoo sensor records linked to the device.

Each mdm.measurement.device.sensor stores:

  • remotecontrol_params with telemetry key in sensor_id (or key for backward compatibility)

Example sensor params:

{
    "sensor_id": "consumo_total"
}

Common telemetry keys (update sensor remotecontrol_params to use):

  • consumo_total - Total accumulated consumption
  • consumo_mensual - Monthly consumption
  • delta - Consumption since last reading

6) API Endpoints Used

  • POST /auth/login - Authenticate and get token
  • GET /auth/user - Get current user profile (customerId)
  • GET /customer/{customerId}/devices?pageSize=100&page=N - List paginated devices
  • GET /plugins/telemetry/DEVICE/{deviceId}/values/timeseries?keys={sensor_id}&startTs={ms}&endTs={ms}&orderBy=DESC - Get historical readings

7) Security & Performance

  • Token-based authentication (expires and is refreshed per run)
  • HTTPS only (enforced by Kuvio platform)
  • Rate limiting between requests (configurable in remotecontrol)
  • Automatic retry on network failures
  • Per-sensor savepoint isolation to avoid aborting the full sync on a single error

8) Readings Storage Behavior

  • All points returned by the telemetry endpoint are processed (not only the latest one)
  • Each point is upserted into mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading using key: sensor_id + measurement_time
  • Value scaling applied: API value / 1000, rounded to 3 decimals before upsert

9) Troubleshooting

  • 401 Unauthorized - Check username/password in connection_params
  • Missing base URL - Configure URL Base field in remotecontrol
  • 404 Device Not Found - Verify device_id in device remotecontrol_params
  • Empty readings - Verify sensor key (sensor_id) and reporting period

# Step 4: Get historical telemetry readings for all sensors (from start_date to now) import requests import json import logging from datetime import datetime, timedelta import time import pytz import calendar
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) Remote = self.remote_id Sensor = env['mdm.measurement.device.sensor'] Reading = env['mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading']
token = bag.get('kuvio_token') base_url = bag.get('base_url') sensor_plan = bag.get('sensor_plan', [])
if not token or not base_url: raise Exception('Login step must be executed first')
if not sensor_plan: raise Exception('Please run "Create Sensor Plan" action first')
total_readings = 0 total_errors = 0
logger.info('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Starting telemetry sync for %d sensors', len(sensor_plan))
headers = {'Authorization': 'Bearer %s' % token} madrid_tz = pytz.timezone('Europe/Madrid') utc_tz = pytz.timezone('UTC') year_start = '%s-01-01' % fields.Date.today()[:4]
# End time: now in UTC (milliseconds) now_utc = datetime.now(utc_tz) end_ts = int(calendar.timegm(now_utc.timetuple()) * 1000)
logger.debug('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] End timestamp: %d ms (now in UTC)', end_ts)
for plan_idx, plan_item in enumerate(sensor_plan, 1): try: with env.cr.savepoint(): odoo_sensor_id = plan_item.get('odoo_sensor_id') key = plan_item.get('key') device_id = plan_item.get('device_id') start_date_str = plan_item.get('start_date')
logger.debug('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Processing plan item %d/%d: sensor_id=%s, device_id=%s, key=%s', plan_idx, len(sensor_plan), odoo_sensor_id, device_id, key)
if not odoo_sensor_id or not key or not device_id: logger.warning('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Plan item incomplete: sensor_id=%s, device_id=%s, key=%s', odoo_sensor_id, device_id, key) total_errors += 1 continue
# Get sensor record sensor = Sensor.browse(odoo_sensor_id) if not sensor.exists(): logger.warning('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Sensor %s does not exist in database', odoo_sensor_id) total_errors += 1 continue
device = sensor.device_id
# Determine initial date priority: # 1) last reading date in any sensor of the device # 2) device remotecontrol_params.start_date # 3) Jan 1 of current year start_ts = None device_last_reading = Reading.search([ ('sensor_id.device_id', '=', device.id), ('active', '=', True) ], order='measurement_time desc', limit=1)
if device_last_reading: last_mt = device_last_reading.measurement_time dt_last_utc = None if isinstance(last_mt, datetime): dt_last_utc = last_mt else: try: dt_last_utc = datetime.strptime(str(last_mt)[:19], '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') except Exception: dt_last_utc = None
if dt_last_utc is not None: if dt_last_utc.tzinfo is None: dt_last_utc = utc_tz.localize(dt_last_utc) else: dt_last_utc = dt_last_utc.astimezone(utc_tz)
# Start just after the last stored reading timestamp. start_ts = int(calendar.timegm(dt_last_utc.timetuple()) * 1000) + 1 start_date_str = dt_last_utc.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') logger.debug('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Device %s has last reading - using timestamp %d', device_id, start_ts) else: start_date_str = str(last_mt)[:10] logger.debug('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Device %s last reading could not be parsed, fallback date %s', device_id, start_date_str) elif start_date_str: start_date_str = str(start_date_str)[:10] logger.debug('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Device %s has no readings - using device start_date %s', device_id, start_date_str) else: start_date_str = year_start logger.debug('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Device %s without readings/start_date - using year start %s', device_id, start_date_str)
# If there is no previous reading timestamp, convert fallback date to timestamp. if start_ts is None: try: dt_madrid = madrid_tz.localize(datetime.strptime(start_date_str, '%Y-%m-%d').replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0)) dt_utc = dt_madrid.astimezone(utc_tz) start_ts = int(calendar.timegm(dt_utc.timetuple()) * 1000) # milliseconds logger.debug('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Converted start_date %s to %d ms (UTC)', start_date_str, start_ts) except Exception as e: logger.error('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Failed to convert start_date %s: %s', start_date_str, e) total_errors += 1 continue
# Build telemetry query URL # Note: endTs is the target time (upper limit), startTs must be well before to ensure data exists telemetry_url = ('%s/plugins/telemetry/DEVICE/%s/values/timeseries?keys=%s' + '&startTs=%d&endTs=%d&orderBy=DESC') % ( base_url, device_id, key, start_ts, end_ts)
logger.info('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Sensor %s: URL=%s/plugins/telemetry/DEVICE/%s/values/timeseries?keys=%s&startTs=%d&endTs=%d&orderBy=DESC', odoo_sensor_id, base_url, device_id, key, start_ts, end_ts)
try: logger.debug('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Fetching telemetry...') response = requests.get(telemetry_url, headers=headers, timeout=30) response.raise_for_status() response_data = response.json()
logger.debug('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] API response received (status=%d)', response.status_code)
# Response structure: {key: [{ts: timestamp, value: value}, ...]} readings = [] if isinstance(response_data, dict): readings = response_data.get(key) or []
if readings: sensor_upserts = 0 for point in readings: if not isinstance(point, dict): continue
timestamp = point.get('ts') value = point.get('value')
if not timestamp or value is None: continue
try: ts_float = float(timestamp) reading_value = round(float(value) / 1000.0, 3) except Exception: logger.warning('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Invalid reading format for sensor %s: ts=%s value=%s', odoo_sensor_id, timestamp, value) total_errors += 1 continue
# Kuvio ts comes in epoch ms. Convert to epoch seconds when needed. if ts_float > 9999999999: ts_float = ts_float / 1000.0
dt_reading_utc = datetime.fromtimestamp(ts_float, utc_tz) measurement_time_str = dt_reading_utc.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
Remote.upsert( 'mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading', { 'sensor_id': odoo_sensor_id, 'measurement_time': measurement_time_str, }, { 'value': reading_value, 'remotecontrol_origin_id': Remote.id, } ) sensor_upserts += 1
total_readings += sensor_upserts logger.info('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Upserted %s readings for sensor %s (device=%s)', sensor_upserts, odoo_sensor_id, device_id) else: logger.warning('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] No data for key=%s on device=%s in time window [%s - now]', key, device_id, start_date_str)
except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e: logger.exception('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Request failed for device %s: %s', device_id, str(e)) total_errors += 1 except Exception as e: logger.exception('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Error processing sensor %s: %s', odoo_sensor_id, str(e)) total_errors += 1 except Exception as e: logger.exception('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Savepoint error in plan item %d: %s', plan_idx, str(e)) total_errors += 1
logger.info('Kuvio: [GetReadingsHistorical] Sync complete - %d readings upserted, %d errors', total_readings, total_errors) result = 'Readings sync complete - %d readings upserted, %d errors' % (total_readings, total_errors)
